items.title: Texans GM Nick Caserio: No knee-jerk reactions, significant personnel changes right now
items.text: The Texans had a chance to head into their bye week on a three-game winning streak, but they couldn't score any points to open overtime against the Giants and their run defense broke down as the visitors rolled to a game-winning touchdown by former Texan Devin Singletary.

items.title: Matthew Stafford: Setting two franchise TD records means "you're old and you've played a lot of ball"
items.text: Whenever Matthew Stafford decides to retire, he'll go down as arguably the best quarterback in franchise history for two teams.

items.title: Liam Coen: Brian Thomas will be able to help us make plays this week
items.text: Jaguars wide receiver Brian Thomas didn't have any catches in the team's final two games before their Week 7 bye and he found himself on the bench for all of the second half of their Week 6 loss to the Texans, which led head coach Liam Coen to say that "guys have to step up and make plays" if they want to be on the field.

items.title: John Harbaugh: Sunday was a pivotal game, our guys took the bull by the horns

items.title: Falcons rookie Kendal Daniels goes from hospital to hero in a week

items.title: Aaron Glenn defends not using timeouts after saying he should have on Sunday
items.text: Jets head coach Aaron Glenn said after Sunday's 28-25 loss to the Dolphins that he should have used the team's timeouts at the end of the first half rather than letting the Dolphins drain the clock before scoring a touchdown to go up 14 points with six seconds left on the clock.

items.title: Baker Mayfield: Sunday's win was a statement of our potential
items.text: Buccaneers quarterback Baker Mayfield said his right thumb might be a little sore after Sunday's win over the Panthers moved the team to 2-5, but he did it with a smile because the cause of the soreness was how often he handed the ball off.

items.title: Klint Kubiak on QB change: We're thinking about everything to fix our problems
items.text: The Raiders lost their fourth straight game on Sunday and head coach Klint Kubiak said that nothing is off the table as they consider ways to halt their slide.

items.title: Dolphins, Jets bring plenty of futility into their first meeting of the year

items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Trade rumors are out there, my wife discussing it doesn't change anything
